title: Keeping AI Out of the Deterministic Compute Path — Check

questions.prompt: Why is the AI search implemented as a deterministic mock rather than a live LLM call during development?
questions.explanation: A deterministic mock yields the same output for the same input, enabling exact assertions and removing flaky external dependencies from tests.
options: LLMs are always too expensive to use
It makes tests reproducible and keeps CI free of network, key, and drift dependencies
It is the only way Netlify supports AI

questions.prompt: What is the core principle for placing AI in this architecture?
questions.explanation: The app lets AI help users find the right deterministic tool but never makes it the source of reported facts, preserving reproducibility and trust.
options: AI should compute the authoritative factual numbers for speed
Probabilistic components can guide and rank, but authoritative computation stays deterministic and verifiable
All endpoints should route through the AI for consistency
AI and deterministic compute should share the same handler

questions.prompt: Because the mock and a future real LLM share the same `aiSearch` signature and live behind the same separate endpoint, swapping in a real model is a localized change.
questions.explanation: True. The mock establishes the contract; honoring the same signature and endpoint keeps the change confined behind the seam, away from the deterministic compute path.
